links.outcome: Oncologists' concern about overreliance on AI
links.effect: 162/228 (71%) of oncologists were concerned about overreliance on AI; 163/228 (71.5%) worried AI could mislead diagnosis and treatment.
links.quote: The study revealed that the most prominent concerns were the potential for AI to mislead diagnosis and treatment (163/228, 71.5%); an overreliance on AI (162/228, 71%); data and algorithm bias (123/228, 54%); issues with data security and patient privacy (123/228, 54%); and a lag in the adaptation of laws, regulations, and policies in keeping up with AI's development (115/228, 50.4%).

screen.reason: The study is a cross-sectional survey of 228 oncologists evaluating their perspectives, concerns, and attitudes toward integrating AI into clinical practice.
